key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as markets price in a fourth RBA rate hike, with house prices forecast to fall up to 10% on record
CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since the federal budget, signalling severe credit contraction
Bathla's collapse exposes systemic fragility in Australia's construction sector, with ratings agencies warning on Victoria's soaring debt
Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle
Lindian Resources secures long-term rare earths offtake with Carester; gold producers (Aurum) add high-grade ounces
EV sales overtake petrol cars in Australia for first time, driven by soaring fuel costs; energy transition costs mounting
ASIC launches review of whistleblower complaints at Big Four accounting firms, raising governance concerns
Natixis shifts allocation from US equities to Japan, reflecting global rotation away from high-valuation tech

sectors.trend: Negative. CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications; banks forecast record house price falls. Legal loophole scrutiny on CBA/Westpac fee practices adds reputational risk. Credit contraction underway.
sectors.implications: NIM pressure from rate hikes offset by credit losses. CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face margin compression as housing demand collapses. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Mixed. Iron ore shakeout underway (geopolitically masked). Macarthur (MAC.AX) clears WA bulk test. Lindian Resources (LDR.AX) locks rare earths offtake. Gold producers (Aurum) add ounces. Small-caps (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche) active.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face iron ore price volatility. Rare earths and gold offer diversification. Small-cap miners show speculative momentum but carry execution risk.

sectors.trend: Positive for gas. TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling. Beetaloo (BTL.AX) gas cartel concerns. Energy transition costs mounting globally. EV adoption accelerates demand-side shift.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, SXG.AX, BTL.AX benefit from gas price strength. Oil & gas names face transition overhang. EV theme supports long-term structural shift.

sectors.trend: Sharply negative. Bathla collapse signals sector-wide stress. Housing construction to follow prices lower. Melbourne councils admit infrastructure cannot cope with population growth. Victoria debt warnings.
sectors.implications: CGP.AX, WBC.AX (mortgage book), REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face demand destruction. Construction names (WTC.AX, IAG.AX) under pressure. Property cycle turning.

sectors.trend: Neutral. Ozempic maker in trouble, tablet alternatives emerging. Darwin ambulance delays highlight public health system strain. Consumer spending constrained by rate hikes.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Healthcare defensive but growth may moderate.

sectors.trend: Cautiously positive. Nvidia signals AI boom continues. Natixis rotates from US to Japan equities. Data centre backlash persists. Tesla Europe sales mixed.
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX exposure but sentiment spillover. Global tech rotation may support AUD-sensitive exporters.

key_themes: RBA fourth rate hike imminent; credit contraction accelerating
Housing cycle inflection: record price falls forecast, construction demand collapsing
Construction sector systemic risk (Bathla) exposing 'Ponzi economy' fragility
Iron ore structural shakeout; rare earths and gold as relative outperformers
Energy transition cost overhang vs. gas price strength
EV adoption inflection point in Australia
ASIC governance scrutiny on Big Four accountants
Global rotation: Natixis cuts US, adds Japan; AI narrative persists

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike and credit contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce leverage exposure; favour cash-flow-positive, low-debt equities; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance
Underweight REITs and construction; avoid high-LVR mortgage-sensitive banks; consider short-duration fixed income
Screen construction and property-adjacent names for balance sheet stress; avoid speculative developers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price volatility / demand shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify materials exposure toward gold, rare earths, and critical minerals; avoid single-commodity concentration

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy transition cost overhang and policy uncertainty
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour established gas producers with hedged revenue; avoid unproven transition-tech small caps

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Cyclone risk (El Nino triplets) on energy/infrastructure
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor insurance and energy infrastructure exposure; WDS.AX, SXG.AX operational risk

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and rare earths producers as inflation/hedge plays amid rate uncertainty
opportunities.rationale: Aurum adding high-grade ounces; Lindian secures long-term offtake; gold benefits from rate-cut expectations post-peak

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gas exposure on TMK Energy rate surge and Beetaloo cartel dynamics
opportunities.rationale: Gas prices firming on supply constraints; Mongolian drilling adds optionality; Beetaloo long-term offtake visibility

opportunities.recommendation: Accumate quality banks on weakness if rate cycle peaks
opportunities.rationale: CBA, NAB, WBC, ANZ likely to see NIM expansion before credit losses bite; 15% loan application drop may be cyclical trough

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and construction exposure; shift to cash or short-duration bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price falls forecast; Bathla contagion risk; construction demand collapsing; Victoria debt warnings

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge iron ore concentration; diversify materials basket
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore shakeout underway; geopolitical masking of structural demand shift; Macarthur bulk test adds supply

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain defensive healthcare and consumer staples allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: CSL, WES, WOW offer earnings visibility amid macro uncertainty; Ozempic disruption is a tailwind for generic alternatives

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend weakness as fourth RBA hike is priced in. Housing data deterioration and Bathla contagion will pressure financials and construction. Iron ore volatility adds noise. Expect ^AXJO to test lower supports. AUD/USD under pressure on rate differential narrowing.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive post-peak. If RBA pauses after fourth hike, credit losses stabilise within 2–3 quarters. Housing correction creates entry points for quality REITs. Rare earths, gold, and gas offer structural growth. Energy transition and EV adoption support medium-term themes. Key risk: construction sector systemic failure.

ASX 200 sector rotation (financials vs. materials vs. defensives)

Gold and rare earths spot prices
